readings.Aries: Everyone in the room can feel you deciding. Make the decision. Let this one be easy.
readings.Taurus: The waiting you've been doing is almost over. You will need to be ready to move. This situation responds well to direct engagement.
readings.Gemini: The idea you abandoned is still good. Pick it up again. Saying less will move this further than saying more.
readings.Cancer: You have been protecting others from your feelings. Consider the cost of that protection. The window for this is shorter than it looks.
readings.Leo: You are visible whether you try to be or not. Make what you're broadcasting intentional. What worked before will not work the same way this time.
readings.Virgo: Something you do automatically would astound someone else if they could see it. Notice your competence. Something you've been measuring incorrectly just corrected itself.
readings.Libra: Your indecision is costing someone something they haven't told you about. One conversation today matters more than the rest combined.
readings.Scorpio: Something is moving beneath the surface. You can feel it. Trust the feeling. The timing is better than it feels.
readings.Sagittarius: The constraint you're chafing against is protecting something worth protecting. Look at what it's protecting. Someone you haven't thought of lately is relevant to this.
readings.Capricorn: Something about how you're spending your time is no longer aligned with what you say you value. Something you've been measuring incorrectly just corrected itself.
readings.Aquarius: Something about the way you've been living is about to change. You've known this for a while. Sleep on it before committing.
readings.Pisces: Something is converging — threads you've been holding separately are about to become the same thread. Trust the slow version of this over the fast one.

calculation_methods: Planetary longitudes: Jean Meeus 'Astronomical Algorithms' low-precision formulae (±1° accuracy)
Retrograde: computed from direction of longitude change vs previous day
Aspects: angular separation with standard orbs (conjunction 8°, sextile 6°, square/trine/opposition 8°, quincunx 3°)
Compatibility: element harmony base score + modality adjustment + date-seeded variance
Daily readings: deterministic date-seed (PRNG) selects from 60-entry per-sign pools + 30-entry suffix pool; 1,800 combinations per sign
